text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document details the test steps I1, which are performed
 on the daily bases D1 as indicated in the titel blockfor the Fault Recorder
 type TPE 2000, manufacturer Enertic.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
The fault recorder should be in service,
Tools and Equipment
Complete set of screwdrivers
Work to be Carried Out
Visual Inspection of the Operation Lamps for
Master unit UR 2000 and Acquisition unit UA ‎250
# Lamp no. 1 means that there is no connection between
 the station and the NCC (not used)
# Lamp no. 2 means that the link between the master and
 Acquisition
unit is fail from master side.
# Lamp no. 3 means that the printer is fail.
# Lamp no. 5 means that the
 wash dog is fail.

Flashing mean that there are some events
